page.overview:
Who is Bear Actor?

The Bear Actor was a man who was dressed as a bear and only appears briefly in The Telltale Head. He is in the documentary Springfield: A City Taken Hostage: Day One dressed a bear. He attacks Jebediah Springfield and is killed, but the acting in the documentary is obviously poor, and the actor's bear costume looks very cartoonish and unrealistic.
